Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api

Schnittstelle BetterNPCsApi

public interface BetterNPCsApi
The root of the BetterNPCs API.

Obtained from BetterNPCs.get() once BetterNPCs has enabled, or from Bukkit's services manager, where it is registered under this interface.

Everything reachable from here is safe for third-party plugins to depend on under the promise described by ApiVersion. Nothing outside the dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api package is.

Seit:
1.0.0

  • Methodendetails

    • apiVersion

      ApiVersion apiVersion()
      Returns the API version this implementation provides.

      Check it at startup if the plugin uses anything added after 1.0.0: 

      
 if (!api.apiVersion().isCompatibleWith(1, 2)) {
     getLogger().severe("BetterNPCs 1.2 or newer is required");
     getServer().getPluginManager().disablePlugin(this);
     return;
 }
      Gibt zurück:
      the API version

    • pluginVersion

      String pluginVersion()
      Returns the version of the BetterNPCs plugin itself.

      For diagnostics. Version checks belong on apiVersion(), which is what actually describes compatibility.

      Gibt zurück:
      the plugin version

    • render

      net.kyori.adventure.text.Component render(String miniMessage, org.bukkit.entity.Player player)
      Renders MiniMessage source, expanding BetterNPCs' own placeholders and, when it is installed, PlaceholderAPI's.

      Offered so that an extension formats text exactly the way the rest of the plugin does, including the tag set and the escaping rules — placeholder values are inserted as literal text rather than re-parsed, so a hostile player name cannot inject formatting or a click event.

      Parameter:
      miniMessage - the MiniMessage source
      player - the player to resolve placeholders for, or null for none
      Gibt zurück:
      the rendered component
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if miniMessage is null
